Title: Public Preview: Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps [Consumption]

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps (Consumption) — bringing agentic intelligence and adaptive workflows to the serverless Logic Apps runtime. 

Agent Loop enables you to move beyond traditional, static automation by creating goal-driven workflows that reason, decide, and act autonomously based on real-time context. With this preview, organizations using the consumption-based Logic Apps SKU can now take advantage of Agent Loop’s flexibility and AI integration without changing their existing hosting model. 

With Agent Loop in Consumption, you can: 

  • Build adaptive, goal-driven workflows that refine actions dynamically until objectives are met. 
  • Integrate AI models and reasoning logic directly into existing consumption-based workflows. 
  • Leverage 1,400+ connectors to provide agents with real-time enterprise context and data. 
  • Gain visibility into agentic flows with logging, diagnostics, and end-to-end observability. 

This public preview extends the power of Agent Loop, enabling you to combine automation, AI, and integration at scale now across both Standard and Consumption Logic Apps environments. 

Learn more:
  • About building agentic workflows.
  • Get started with Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps.
